description: This PHP source file defines a controller class `SaveQualificationMembershipController` within the OrangeHRM project. The class extends an abstract controller and manages pre-render logic for qualification membership views, selecting between edit and save components based on the request attributes.

classes.name: SaveQualificationMembershipController
classes.description: Controller handling the pre-render logic for qualification membership views, choosing different Vue components based on presence of an 'id' attribute in the request.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component to be rendered. Checks if the request has an 'id' attribute and selects an appropriate Vue component ('qualification-membership-edit' or 'qualification-membership-save'), passing the 'id' as a prop if available.
